parts.text: $AMC Q3 2026: revenue reached $1.7B, up 32% Y/Y, driven by admissions growth. Operating margin was 14.5%. #earnings #streaming
$CHRD Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $1.7B, +30% Y/Y, driven by oil volumes above guidance and strong realizations. Operating margin 29.6%; operating cash flow $781M. #earnings #oil

$ARDT Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $1.6B, +3% Y/Y, driven by a 2.9% increase in adjusted admissions. Operating margin 5.0%; net earnings $45M. Guides FY26 revenue to $6.4B–$6.7B. #earnings #healthcare
$STE Q2 FY27 (preliminary): revenue $1.6B, +9% Y/Y, driven by strong Life Sciences performance and solid healthcare demand. Operating margin was 18.5%. #earnings #medtech
$Q Q3 2026: revenue $1.6B, +22% Y/Y, driven by volume growth across Interconnect Solutions and Semiconductor Technologies. Operating margin 15.9%; operating cash flow $271M. #earnings #semiconductors
$COTY Q1 FY27 (preliminary): revenue $1.6B, -1% Y/Y, as top core prestige brands returned to growth. Operating margin reached 11.0% and net earnings were $110M. #earnings #consumer
$ALB Q3 2026: revenue $1.6B, up 19% Y/Y, driven by higher pricing in Energy Storage and Specialties. Operating margin was 9.5%. #earnings #materials
$ALSN Q3 2026: revenue $1.5B, +121% Y/Y, driven by the Dana off-highway acquisition and higher North America On-Highway demand. Operating margin 19.8%; operating cash flow $343M. #earnings #autos
$AGL Q3 2026: revenue $1.5B, +6% Y/Y, driven by improved medical services expense ratios as the company exited unprofitable markets. Operating margin 1.6%. #earnings #healthcare
$OPCH Q3 2026: revenue $1.5B, +4% Y/Y, driven by acute portfolio growth offsetting chronic portfolio headwinds. Operating margin 6.0%. #earnings #healthcare
$ARM Q2 FY27: revenue $1.4B, +27% Y/Y, driven by external customer revenue growth. Operating margin 13.9%. #earnings #semiconductors
$ITT Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue reached $1.4B, +44% Y/Y, driven by the SPX FLOW acquisition and aerospace strength. Operating margin stood at 15.7%. #earnings #industrials
